title: Finance & Investment
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! El vocabulario financiero es el idioma de los negocios. Ahora puedes leer reportes y hablar de inversiones y rentabilidad con la confianza de un banquero o CFO.

parts.visual:
Términos de Inversión y Ganancias: 
- ROI (Return on Investment / Retorno de la inversión). 
Ej: What is the expected ROI for this project? 
- Equity (Capital / Acciones de una empresa privada). 
Ej: He owns 10% equity in the startup. 
- Dividend (Dividendo / Parte de las ganancias repartida a los accionistas). 
Ej: The company pays an annual dividend.
parts.audio: Investment and Profit terms. R O I stands for Return on Investment. It measures the profitability of an investment. For example: What is the expected R O I for this project? 'Equity' refers to ownership in a company, usually in the form of shares. For example: He owns 10% equity in the startup. A 'Dividend' is a portion of the company's profit paid to its shareholders. For example: The company pays an annual dividend.

parts.visual:
Mercado y Riesgo: 
- Stock market (Bolsa de valores). 
Ej: She made a fortune investing in the stock market. 
- Bankruptcy (Bancarrota / Quiebra). 
Ej: If we don't increase sales, we will face bankruptcy. 
- Liability (Pasivo / Deuda legal u obligación). 
Ej: The company has more liabilities than assets (activos).
parts.audio: Market and Risk. 'Stock market' is where shares of public companies are bought and sold. For example: She made a fortune investing in the stock market. 'Bankruptcy' is a legal status of a person or company that cannot repay its debts. For example: If we don't increase sales, we will face bankruptcy. 'Liability' is a legal debt or obligation. For example: The company has more liabilities than assets.

questions.question: Before funding the project, the investors want to know the expected ____. (Retorno de Inversión).
I would like 5% ____ in your startup in exchange for my $100,000. (Capital / Participación accionaria).
questions.explanation: Equity = participación en el capital de una empresa.

questions.question: Apple pays a ____ to its shareholders every quarter. (Dividendo).
questions.explanation: Dividend = dividendo (parte de las ganancias repartidas).

questions.question: He lost all his savings playing the ____ market. (Bolsa de valores).
Due to massive debts, the airline had to declare ____. (Bancarrota).
In accounting, properties and cash are ____, while loans and debts are ____. (Activos / Pasivos).
If you don't pay your mortgage, the bank will seize your ____. (Colateral / Garantía).
questions.explanation: Collateral = garantía (normalmente un bien físico) que respalda un préstamo.

questions.question: A ____ market means stock prices are falling and investors are pessimistic. (Mercado bajista).
questions.explanation: Bear market = mercado a la baja. (Bull market = al alza).

questions.question: A ____ market means stock prices are rising and the economy is strong. (Mercado alcista).
When a private company offers shares to the public for the first time, it's called an ____. (Oferta Pública Inicial).
questions.explanation: IPO (Initial Public Offering) = Oferta pública inicial (salir a bolsa).

questions.question: We need to secure ____ capital to open the new factory. (Capital semilla/de riesgo).
Our total ____ for the year were $1 million, but our net profit was only $100k. (Ingresos / Facturación).
A bond's ____ date is when the principal amount must be paid back. (Fecha de vencimiento).
questions.explanation: Maturity date = fecha de vencimiento (de un bono o préstamo).

questions.question: Because of ____, the cost of living goes up every year. (Inflación).
Our profit ____ is too thin. We need to increase prices. (Margen de ganancia).
The company decided to ____ its operations to reduce costs. (Externalizar / Subcontratar).
A ____ is a person who buys and sells shares for clients. (Corredor de bolsa).
We are operating at a ____. We spend more than we earn. (Déficit / Pérdida).
questions.explanation: Deficit = déficit (o también 'operating at a loss').

questions.question: After deducting all taxes and expenses, the ____ profit was $50,000. (Ganancia neta).
questions.explanation: Net profit = ganancia neta. (Gross profit = bruta).

questions.question: If you don't pay your debts, you will ruin your credit ____. (Calificación crediticia).
questions.explanation: Credit score / Credit rating = calificación o puntaje crediticio.

questions.question: Return on Investment. (Acrónimo de 3 letras)
____ market. (Bolsa de valores con S)
Declare ____. (Bancarrota con B)
5% ____. (Participación/Capital con E)
Pay a ____. (Dividendo con D)
____ and liabilities. (Activos con A)
A ____ market. (Mercado bajista con B de oso)
A ____ market. (Mercado alcista con B de toro)
Total ____. (Ingresos/Facturación con R)
Profit ____. (Margen con M)
